items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1972-05-29
items.q: because this band has two bass fiddles. Al Holmes and Trini Johnson.

ctx.x: See, in this band, we had five arranges. There was no one sound to the band. I mean, no. I don't feel that you copied. What? A set patent. Yeah, I don't think you copied anybody. It's a lot of variety in the band.

It's all original arrangements. Individual stylists. Well, I'll say this. We did copy a few numbers that are not recorded on here. In the same vein as Duke played, we used the same instrumentation and the same sound. Because the band was closely related, because this band has two bass fiddles. Al Holmes and Trini Johnson.
He swings with every note that trumpet plays. That's right. It must be Billy, huh? That's Billy.
